questions.question: If sec θ + tan θ = √3, then find the positive value of sin θ + cos θ.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If **sec θ + tan θ = k**, then **sec θ − tan θ = 1/k**.

Given **sec θ + tan θ = √3** ⇒ **sec θ − tan θ = 1/√3**.

Adding both: **2 sec θ = √3 + 1/√3 = 4/√3** ⇒ **sec θ = 2/√3**.

This corresponds to the standard angle **θ = 30°**.

Calculation: **sin 30° + cos 30° = 1/2 + √3/2 = (1 + √3)/2**.

**∴ The correct answer is ((1+√3))/(2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sec θ + tan θ = √3

**Formula Used:** sec² θ − tan² θ = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a99ffb5eebe8eb40231e4bdfaab460b865f6317549ee16c9480d17f476b5ae0d.png] 

⇒ (sec θ + tan θ)(sec θ − tan θ) = 1

⇒ √3 × (sec θ − tan θ) = 1 ⇒ sec θ − tan θ = 1/√3

⇒ Add the equations: (sec θ + tan θ) + (sec θ − tan θ) = √3 + 1/√3

⇒ 2 sec θ = 4/√3 ⇒ sec θ = 2/√3

⇒ cos θ = 1/sec θ = √3/2

⇒ From tan θ = sec θ − 1/√3 = 2/√3 − 1/√3 = 1/√3

⇒ sin θ = tan θ × cos θ = (1/√3) × (√3/2) = 1/2

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = 1/2 + √3/2 = (1 + √3)/2

**∴ The correct answer is ((1+\sqrt3))/(2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

Standard square relations include sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Conjugate Pairs in Trigonometry

Pairs like (sec θ + tan θ) and (sec θ − tan θ) are reciprocals of each other because their product equals 1.

Trigonometric Ratios for 30°

At 30°, the ratios are: sin 30° = 1/2, cos 30° = √3/2, tan 30° = 1/√3, and sec 30° = 2/√3.</p

Let the time = T years

As per the question,

​⇒ 1296 × 5 × T / 100 - 986 × 5 × T / 100 = 62

**∴ The correct option is 1**

questions.question: The average weight of a group of 12 children is 66 kg. If 2 children, X and Y, join the group in place of A and B, the new average weight becomes 65 kg. Weight of A = weight of B and weight of X = weight of Y. Another child C is added to the group, and the new average weight remains 65 kg. Weight of C = Weight of X. Find the weight of A.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of a group of 12 children is 66 kg.

The new average weight = 65 kg

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

2A - 2X = (66 - 65) × 12

⇒ A - X = 6

Again,

Total weight of those 12 people and addition of C = 65 kg

So the weight of C = X = 65 kg

weight of A is 65 + 6 = 71 kg.

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question: If the cost price of a book is 92% of its selling price, then what will be the profit percentage on the sale of the book (correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Cost price of a book is 92% of its selling price.

**Concept used:**

Selling price - cost price = profit

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price is Rs 100

Then cost price is 100 × 92/100 = Rs 92

Profit will be 100 - 92 = Rs 8

Profit percentage,

⇒ (8/92) × 100 = 8.69%

** ∴ The correct option is 4**

questions.question: Δ ABC ∼ Δ PQR, AB = 12 cm, PQ = 18 cm, and perimeter of Δ ABC is 45 cm. Find the perimeter of Δ PQR.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **similar triangles**, the ratio of their **perimeters** is equal to the ratio of their **corresponding sides**.

Ratio of sides **AB : PQ** = 12 : 18 = 2 : 3.

Let the perimeter of **Δ PQR** be x.

⇒ 45 / x = 2 / 3

⇒ x = (45 × 3) ÷ 2 = 67.5 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 67.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Δ ABC ∼ Δ PQR, **AB** = 12 cm, **PQ** = 18 cm, and **Perimeter(Δ ABC)** = 45 cm.

**Formula Used:**

If two triangles are **similar**, then the ratio of their perimeters is equal to the ratio of their **corresponding sides**: 
 Perimeter(Δ ABC) ÷ Perimeter(Δ PQR) = AB ÷ PQ = BC ÷ QR = AC ÷ PR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df8e9a6b92f3a7a2a71ab2da88ba891062e77f71f084d64352ce18eab9977b68.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the perimeter of **Δ PQR** be **P₂**.

⇒ 45 ÷ P₂ = 12 ÷ 18

⇒ 45 ÷ P₂ = 2 ÷ 3

⇒ 2 × P₂ = 45 × 3

⇒ 2 × P₂ = 135

⇒ P₂ = 135 ÷ 2

⇒ P₂ = 67.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 67.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Similar Triangles

If Δ ABC ∼ Δ PQR, then the ratio of their corresponding altitudes, medians, and angle bisectors is also equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Ratio of Areas

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area(Δ ABC) ÷ Area(Δ PQR) = (AB ÷ PQ)².

AA Similarity Criterion

If two angles of one triangle are respectively equal to two angles of another triangle, then the two triangles are similar (Angle-Angle Similarity).</p

questions.question: MN is the diameter of a circle with center O. P and S are two points situated on the circumference of the circle on either side of MN such that ∠PMN = 50° and ∠MNS = 35°. What will be the measure of the degree of difference between ∠PMS and ∠PNS?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

MN is the diameter of a circle with center O.

 ∠PMN = 50° and ∠MNS = 35°.

**Calculation: **

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42b712264d49bdfe76aa86fb41718000eae4838fa1f9a0cdf7504b6af99b77ea.png] 

∠P = 90° as an angle in a semi-circle.

So, ∠PNM = 90° - 50° = 40°

Similarly ∠S = 90° as an angle in semi-circle.

So, ∠SMN = 90° - 35° = 55°

So ∠PMS = 50° + 55° = 105° and ∠PNS = 40° + 35° = 75°

The difference between ∠PMS and ∠PNS is 

⇒ 105° - 75° = 30° 

**∴ The correct option is 1**
